The '''2016–17 Czech First League''', known as the '''[[Czech First League|ePojisteni.cz liga]]''' for sponsorship reasons, was the 24th season of the [[Czech Republic]]'s top-tier [[Association football|football]] league. [[SK Slavia Prague|Slavia Prague]] won the league, while defending champions [[FC Viktoria Plzeň|Viktoria Plzeň]] finished in second place. The season began on 29 July 2016 and ended on 27 May 2017.
